snippet.title: Dino Age: Survive the Eras – Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4451860/Dino_Age_Survive_the_Eras/

One island. Three prehistoric eras. Can you survive them all?

Step into a world ruled by dinosaurs in Dino Age: Survive the Eras, a single-player 2D survival RPG.

Follow Owen’s journey across the Triassic, Jurassic and Cretaceous. Gather resources, train your skills and craft stronger gear. Search for hidden paths and dinosaur nests, hatch a companion and face dangerous creatures and Guardians.

Travel back and forth through time to mend the island’s fractures. One action in the past can open a path in the future.

We’re Mark & Jimmy, the two creators behind Dino Age. Survive the Eras is currently in development.

Discover more: https://dinoage.online/

#DinoAge #SurviveTheEras #DinosaurGame
